question: Whether a newly observed corrupted direct comment-submission email address falls within the frozen extra-assertion gate.

reported_example.evidence_status: Reported by primary/reviewer; this advice interprets the frozen scope and does not replace primary source/output verification.

frozen_sources.criticality: Freeze before vendor outputs; critical when loss/wrong association can change notice identity/lifecycle, participation opportunity, date role/precision, deadline condition, eligibility or withdrawal scope. Do not make agency/contact/lexical trivia critical merely to meet a quota.
frozen_sources.extra_assertion_scope: Bounded sweep of the complete retained notice output for added/contradictory participation dates, lifecycle/withdrawal scope, temporal anchors, and checked/unchecked selections. Include critical facts outside the 6-10 reference questions.
frozen_sources.document_gate_formula: PASS iff reference gate eligible AND completed nonempty parse output AND every eligible critical field passes its answerability-specific gate AND no critical incorrect assertion found in the notice-wide extra-assertion audit.
frozen_sources.round2_audit_scope: The reviewer sweeps every retained notice for extra or contradictory participation dates, temporal anchors, selected states, lifecycle and withdrawal scope, including facts outside the selected questions.

recommendation: Do not broaden the predeclared strict gate to submission destinations after observing held-out outputs. Record the error in a separate supplemental actionability/safety audit and as a deployment/activation concern; keep the original frozen gate result unchanged by this finding alone.
reasoning: A direct submission address has a functional role: a changed address can misdirect comments. It is consequential evidence, unlike incidental contact spelling. No claim is made that a message actually bounced or that participation was actually lost.

The reference criticality definition broadly includes participation opportunity, but it governs source-only selection/freeze of critical questions; it does not unambiguously expand the separately specified bounded extra-assertion sweep.

Both frozen extra-audit scope statements enumerate participation dates, temporal anchors, selections, lifecycle and withdrawal scope. Submission channels/destinations are not named, and H01 has no frozen destination field.

The clause about facts outside selected questions permits extra assertions in the enumerated audit categories. Reading it as any potentially consequential field after outputs makes the gate elastic and undermines predeclared scope.

An expanded destination/channel audit can be useful if clearly labeled post-hoc and applied symmetrically across all held-out arms/notices, with separate denominators and gate results. It cannot silently replace the frozen strict-gate table.
primary_decision_needed: Verify the literal source/output error, retain original scoring, and decide practical deployment safeguards separately. If primary interprets the broader wording differently, record the ambiguity and present original-scope and expanded-scope results separately, rather than imply the expanded scope was unambiguously frozen.
